added.name: Nakagin Capsule Tower
added.description: The digital shadow of the former Nakagin Capsule Tower which was a mixed-use residential and office tower designed by architect Kisho Kurokawa and located in Shimbashi, Tokyo, Japan. Completed in 1972, the building was a rare remaining example of Japanese Metabolism, an architectural movement emblematic of Japan's postwar cultural resurgence.
